_notes.lineNumbers: Real, and on by default. Fanuc operators edit at the control and search by block number; an unnumbered program is painful to work with. Steps of 5 leave room to insert.
_notes.dwellUnit: G04 P is milliseconds, integer, with no decimal point.
_notes.rotary: A (about X) and B (about Y) are the words the rotary geometry can produce; C would need a table about Z, which the CylMap slicer cannot express. G93 is native and the only correct feed mode for mixed linear/rotary motion: the control cannot synchronise mm with degrees under G94. maxInverseTime: Fanuc alarms on F overflow under G93, and microscopic segments are exactly what a relief raster produces. indexDwell is 0: a machining-centre rotary has a hydraulic or pneumatic clamp and exact-stop. Raise it in Machine Settings if the table is belt-driven.
_notes.defaults: generateHeader and generateFooter emit the whole safe-start and park sequence. These are the user's EXTRAS, appended inside the right place in each sequence.
